# ShipSignal

Package tracking for Muse, across multiple carriers. Give Muse a tracking number and ShipSignal returns the parcel's status and history in one place. Pricing is set by the provider; see current rates on their site. Created by Telep IO; the service runs at muse.telep.io.

- Listing: https://theskillharbor.com/products/telep-shipsignal

## Install with Muse

1. Open the listing page above.
2. Copy the install package from the page.
3. Paste it into Muse and follow the steps there.

Installs on Skill Harbor are copy-paste into Muse, never automatic.
